Notice of Book Closure for 17th Quarterly Profit Payment of Privately Placed, DSLR Listed 
Term Finance Issue (TFC-VII) Issue of Rs, 6,000 Million (Dated March 17,2020)
This is to inform you that the 17th quarterly profit payment of Rated, Unsecured, OTC Listed Perpetual Term 
Finance Certificates (TFC-VII) Issue of Rs. 6,000 Million (Issue date March 17, 2020) of the Bank is due on 
June 17, 2024. The transfer books pertaining to this issue shall remain closed from June 07, 2024 to 
June 14, 2024 (both days inclusive).
